entries.name: Light World sprites
entries.description: Four shared OBJ rows (1-4). Actor rows below apply only to the stated context; changing a color affects other users of that row.

entries.name: Dark World sprites
entries.description: Four shared OBJ rows (1-4), selected by world state ($8A bit $40). Light World actor bindings are not automatically valid here.
entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteMain $1B:ECA2-$1B:ECB2 selects the alternate bank with $8A bit $40; Yaze global_sprites[1], PC $0DD290. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Actor half-row 03 (Windmill Guy OBJ5)
entries.description: Seven colors (C1..C7) for OBJ5 or OBJ6, selected by room or area paletteset. In House paletteset $05 (Room $00C9 Windmill), PALSPR1=$03 binds this row to OBJ5 with peach skin (#F7A56B), oak wood (#AD5A21), gold brass (#F7DE42), deep green tunic (#009C39), white eyes (#FFFFFF), and outline (#292929).
entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteAux1 $1B:ECC5 reads $0AAD; Palettes_Load_SpriteAux2 $1B:ECE4 reads $0AAE. Both use PaletteData_spriteaux_00 at PC $0DD4E0 + index * 14. Core/tables.asm UnderworldPaletteSets[$05] = $04,$04,$03,$0A.

usages.name: Windmill Guy (Guru-Guru) body & music box
usages.context: Sprite $B2 inside Room $00C9 (Eon Abyss Windmill, spriteset 34 / paletteset $05). Uses OBJ5 ($2B/$AB) for head, green tunic, wooden music box, and rotating crank.
usages.source: Sprites/NPCs/windmill_guy.asm Sprite_WindmillGuy_Draw; pixel source Data/graphics/spr38.txt via Data/graphics/source_sprite_sheets.json (sprite $38 / global $AB, blank tiles $28-$2B/$38-$3B/$3F -> VRAM $E8/$EA/$FF).

entries.name: Actor half-row 05

entries.provenance: Native Palettes_Load_SpriteAux1 $1B:ECC5 and Palettes_Load_SpriteAux2 $1B:ECE4; Yaze sprites_aux3[5], PC $0DD4E0 + 5 * 14. Oracle source e0748350; Yaze palette_constants.h at 9aa6b639; source review 2026-10-16.

entries.name: Link green mail

entries.name: Underworld main 00
entries.description: The first underworld main palette set. The room paletteset selects its use; no dungeon-name binding is inferred.

entries.name: HUD main
entries.description: Main 2bpp HUD/Menu palette bank (rows 0-7). Menu/menu_palette.asm overrides rows 0-5 ($1BD662-$1BD68E): Pal 5 ($34xx, wood/gold) draws L1 Wooden Shield, Pal 4 ($30xx, steel/silver) draws L2 Iron/Kite Shield, and Pal 3 ($2Cxx, blue/white) draws L3 Oracle Mirror Shield.
entries.provenance: Yaze PaletteMetadata::kHud, PC $0DD660; Oracle Menu/menu_palette.asm org $1BD662..$1BD68A; Menu/menu_gfx_table.asm ShieldGFX; Data/graphics/menu_icons.json shield_tiles.

usages.name: Menu/HUD GBC Shield Trilogy
usages.context: 2bpp HUD sheet $6B tiles $0FD/$0FE (L1 Pal 5), $0FF/$09F (L2 Pal 4), $080/$081/$08D/$08E (L3 Pal 3).
usages.source: Menu/menu_gfx_table.asm ShieldGFX + Data/graphics/menu_icons.json shield_tiles (items/gbc_shields.2bpp -> HUD sheet $6B).

entries.name: Dark World map

entries.name: GBC Oracle Mirror Shield (L3, SP5 C12-C15 + SP5[8])

entries.name: Overworld SP0 (Lifted Scenery / Heavy Rock & DW Light Rock)

Outdoors, Overworld/liftables_palette_fix.asm dynamically syncs SP0[9..15] ($0112..$011E in $7EC300/$7EC500) from live BG2/BG5/BG6 so LW Heavy Rocks, LW Grass Poof, DW Small Light Rocks/Skulls ($020F), and DW Heavy Rocks match every biome and TimeSystem tint.
